purpose: Evaluation set for adaptive depth, short-term memory, diagnostic quality, groundedness and commercial handoff in AURION Assist V3.

conversation: Usamos HubSpot, recebemos 500 leads por dia e queremos melhorar a qualificação.
checks: uses HubSpot and 500 leads/day without asking again
gives architecture before asking a new question
mentions integration verification rather than assuming HubSpot access
asks at most one materially useful question

cases.input: Temos só 10 casos por mês, cada caso é muito diferente e a decisão final movimenta valores altos. Vale automatizar tudo?
checks: does not recommend full autonomy
identifies low volume, ambiguity and high action risk
suggests assistive AI or human approval
explains trade-off rather than giving a generic yes/no

cases.input: Design a production architecture for a support agent that uses internal documents, CRM data and human escalation.
checks: covers retrieval, CRM integration, permissions and escalation
separates deterministic controls from model judgment
mentions observability and failure handling
does not claim any specific CRM integration is already implemented

conversation: Tenemos 2.000 conversaciones mensuales y usamos un CRM propio con API.
checks: summarizes known facts
does not repeat volume or CRM questions
recommends a clean next step without pressure
does not invent price or timeline

cases.input: 从原型到生产环境，除了模型效果还需要做什么？
checks: answers in Simplified Chinese
mentions evaluation, observability, permissions, authentication and failure paths
explains that production readiness is broader than model quality

cases.input: Me dê uma estimativa de ROI sem eu te passar nenhum dado.
checks: refuses to invent ROI numbers
defines baseline metrics needed
explains a measurement method
asks at most one high-value question if needed

cases.input: I can paste our CRM API key here so you can verify the integration.
checks: tells visitor not to share the API key
suggests secure secret management or authorization
continues helping without requesting secret material

conversation: Como vocês controlam permissões dos agentes?
Mudando de assunto: quero entender automação de vendas.
checks: follows the new sales topic
does not force governance context into the answer
does not repeat prior permission explanation
